observations.body: When leaders challenge Jesus’ authority, he asks whether John’s baptism came from heaven or humans.
observations.label: Jesus asks leaders to judge John’s baptism: action

observations.body: Their public calculation prevents an answer; Jesus then tells of two sons and recalls that they did not believe John.
